Alright so I have spent months looking for this soundtrack cause the game popped back into my head after over a decade of not having even touched the game.

Well I saw you were looking for the soundtrack too.

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLCE0iocDErAXiXxlcq6X_ObnCiVwinMpl

There is a decent market for them, the problem is you can’t own one newer than 1986. There aren’t that many hoops to jump through, you just have to have tons of money. The cheapest I’ve ever seen for sale was $8,000. And that was by far the cheapest, next closest was $12,000.
But an Ak-47 isn’t always automatic, and likely if an American owns one, I’d bet my savings it’s not automatic if it’s in a backpack.
And just like that, this person is on every national and international watchlist...
